sources.title: GitHub - pforge-ai/prompt-forge
sources.snippet: Prompt Forge is a Python framework designed for the automated optimization of prompts for large language models (LLMs). Inspired by the iterative training processes used in machine learning, Prompt Forge aims to systematically discover highly effective prompts based on evaluation metrics and datasets, particularly for scenarios involving API-only LLM access.
